chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Long engagements and the one attempted rehearsal
summary: The trio stayed in clubs a long time, and their only attempt at rehearsing, in Washington, was ended by the customers.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What were the places that you played like?
... We didn't play too many places because when we got to a place they kept us. We ended up in

Washington, at some little club, I don't know what the name of it was... We stayed down there a long time. That was one of the first times that we had decided, because we met at the club every day, it was open, we'd set down there and play -- give a free matinee. We loved playing, just play, if we were somewhere, we played. And they had a piano and we said, we're gonna have a rehearsal. And we tried to have this rehearsal on Minuet in G, but the people in the club, they don't wanna hear no rehearsal. "Play, man," you know, and they get on your nerves. So they got on our case and we had to leave it go and play or go home. So we played a while and then I think we left. That's the only time there was an attempt to rehearse. And we didn't ever get the piece. So that was that.
